definition: Party of the second part indicates the party mentioned second in documents such as deeds and contracts in order to avoid repeating their names. The first party is referred to as the “party of the first part”. This is an archaic phrase. Modern contractual practice is to identify the parties by the short form of their names, or by an identifier such as buyer, seller, licensee, licensor, lessee or lessor. partner / party of the second part Dictionary compilation | 26 September 2026
